name: Counterweight
weather: overcast, smoke haze drifting between towers
designIntent: Crack the checkpoint fortresses sealing the western districts so Compact columns and the risen population can move — siege warfare fought under collateral rules.

briefing.speaker: Relay
briefing.text: The Directorate runs Vell like a mine: everything gated, everything metered. Their grip on the western districts is three checkpoint fortresses — Counterweight Row, the locals call it — sitting on the only mech-rated crossings over the freight canyons. While those fortresses stand, the districts stay sealed, and half a million people who rose with the coast are locked in with Directorate patrols. Crack the Row and the west opens: our columns cross, the districts breathe, and Kryce loses the ability to pretend Vell is calm. Each fortress is a pop-up turret belt, a Ferric garrison, and a heavy anchor mech — a Basalt at the first two. Watchers say the third has a Batholith, so save your legs and your ammunition. Collateral discipline stands: those crossings hold up streets full of homes, so the fortresses die but the bridges stay standing. Sub-target. Be surgical. Tremor breaches, Sable overwatches the canyon lines, Vireo runs flank screen. Open my city, Lodestar. District by district.

objectives.title: Fortress West-One
objectives.description: Crack the first checkpoint fortress and raise the Compact signal over it.

objectives.title: Fortress West-Two
objectives.description: Crack the second checkpoint fortress guarding the mid-canyon crossing.

objectives.title: Fortress West-Three
objectives.description: Crack the final checkpoint fortress, anchored by a pre-ranged Batholith siege mech.

objectives.title: Keep the Crossings
objectives.description: Prevent the destruction of the freight-canyon crossings the fortresses sit on.

objectives.title: The Drone Roost
objectives.description: Destroy the drone re-arm pad cycling swarms to the Row.

enemyForces: Three checkpoint fortresses with pop-up twin-autocannon turret belts and Ferric garrisons
Basalt anchor mechs at West-One and West-Two
Batholith siege mech at West-Three, pre-ranged on the crossing
Drone swarms cycling from a re-arm pad behind the Row
Halite counter-attack pairs moving along the canyon rim between fortresses
setPieces: The Batholith's gauss fire tears girders off the crossing in pre-ranged bracketing shots
District crowds appear on the balconies as each fortress falls, scattering salt — the Veyran gesture of mourning and thanks — down onto the plazas
Tremor shoulder-breaches West-Two's gate wall on command
Compact columns roll across the canyon crossing as the last fortress burns
salvageNotes: Fortress anchors are prime salvage: both Basalts, and especially the West-Three Batholith — leg it rather than coring it and its gauss spines come home to the Assembly Bay. Turret wreckage yields ballistic ammunition stores. Anything knocked into the freight canyons is gone for good.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Three locks on the western door. Break them in any order — the Row talks to itself, so expect each one meaner than the last.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: Point me at the gate wall. Architecture's just an enemy that stands still. HA!

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: West-One's flying Compact grey! And — there are people on the balconies. They're throwing salt down. All of them.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Counter-attack pair inbound along the canyon rim. They intend to catch you between fortresses.

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Batholith. Pre-ranged on the crossing. It will bracket you in two shots. Don't be where the first one lands.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Gauss impact pattern suggests predictive fire. Recommend irregular throttle.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: The crossing's load rating is failing on the north girder. Redirect your fire, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Kryce
voTriggers.line: To the western districts: the Directorate acknowledges localized disruption. Services will resume. They always do. Ask your grandparents.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Multiple zone breaches. Preserve the machine. The west can wait twenty minutes for repairs. It has waited eighteen months.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: The Row is OPEN! Roll the columns, Relay! Vell's got a west side again!

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Columns are across, districts are rising, and Kryce just lost half his city between breakfast and dark. Next stop is the Registry — and everything it knows.
